name: Extract embedded emails
description: Extract embedded emails using Microsoft Graph.

user.title: User
user.description: Mailbox containing the message. For phishing reports, use the reporting mailbox.

message_id.title: Graph Message ID
message_id.description: Graph ID of the message in this mailbox. For phishing reports, use id from the raw report event, not email.message_id. Copy the full ID; Internet Message-IDs (<...@...>) are not accepted.

graph_attachment_type.description: Graph @odata.type supplied for the attachment; empty when absent.

detected_format.description: Content-based parsing route, independent of filename. msg identifies an OLE signature; successful extraction confirms readable email content.

error_details.description: Safe structured errors. retryable refers to retrying the whole action; it is false after a modifying request.

outcome.description: Overall action outcome. Partial, failed and unknown outcomes also flag an SDK action error; inspect retained results before retrying.

headers.description: Decoded transport headers in source order, including repeated fields. Export the EML for byte-preserving evidence.

headers_map.description: Lowercase header names mapped to arrays of values. Repeated values are preserved.

headers_available.description: Whether transport headers were available in the source. MSG headers synthesized from MAPI properties are excluded.

authentication_results.description: First source Authentication-Results header; all occurrences remain in headers_map. This is evidence, not an independently verified verdict.
